news.title: Hybride of all-electric: Remeha Confida past perfect in elke situatie

summary: Remeha is dutch heating company, founded in 2004. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Remeha is a heating and indoor climate brand of BDR Thermea Group, an IND visa sponsor with a mid-level finance job in Apeldoorn.

culture.text: Part of BDR Thermea Group, a team of 7,000 serving customers in over 100 countries with indoor climate solutions for the energy transition.
Says it values innovation, customer focus and a close team culture.
Its one open role here is a mid-level finance job in Apeldoorn.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Remeha B.V.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.

worth_knowing.text: Its products include the Confida heat pump range, offered in hybrid and all-electric versions.
